question: Which chapter concludes in the text called Determination of Knowledge issued from Candra-dvipa?
premises: The verse is a concluding statement.
It names the work as Determination of Knowledge in the Great Kaula.
It specifies the work as issued from Candra-dvipa and gives an ordinal chapter number.
inference: Therefore, this is the eighteenth chapter in the Great Kaula Determination of Knowledge issued from Candra-dvipa.
plain_english: Thus ends the eighteenth chapter in the Great Kaula Determination of Knowledge, issued from Candra-dvipa.
